categories.name: ADMIN
categories.negative_guidance: Use SECURITY for threats and FINANCE for money matters.

categories.name: FINANCE
categories.negative_guidance: Use PURCHASE for order confirmations and receipts.

categories.name: PURCHASE
categories.negative_guidance: Use FINANCE for standalone bills and banking.

categories.name: APPOINTMENT
categories.definition: Scheduled meetings or bookings requiring calendar attention.
categories.negative_guidance: Use TRAVEL for transport or lodging itineraries.

categories.name: PROFESSIONAL
categories.negative_guidance: Use ADMIN for routine account administration.

categories.name: PERSONAL
categories.negative_guidance: Use PURCHASE or TRAVEL for transactional details.

categories.name: SECURITY
categories.positive_guidance: Login alerts, password resets, suspicious activity.
categories.negative_guidance: Use ADMIN for ordinary account notices.

categories.name: UNCERTAIN
categories.definition: Insufficient evidence for a primary category.
categories.positive_guidance: Use when available metadata does not support a confident choice.
categories.negative_guidance: Do not use merely because a message needs a reply.
